title: devcontainer-kit host profile (~/.config/dck/profile.toml or profiles/<name>.toml), interface 2

host_machine.description: Alias of [host] machine (kept for profiles written before v0.2.3): the mesh pushes the host as a peer

identity.description: Dedicated key dck authorizes in containers

host_extra.description: aliases or host names beyond the git hosting services whose ~/.ssh/config blocks ssh_host_config also copies into containers (opt-in, host-side only)

authorized_extra.description: public key files (paths ending in .pub) also authorized in every container's dck block, e.g. the keys non-dck containers log in with (host profile only)

host.description: the host as a mesh peer (docs/herdr.md)

machine.description: push the host to the containers as dck-host; unset falls back to host_machine

listener.description: dck: dck's own loopback listener (dck host listener enable); external: one you already run (set port and host_key); remote-login: the system sshd on port 22

port.description: 0 = the listener's default (dck 22033, remote-login 22); required for external

host_key.description: path of the listener's PUBLIC ed25519 host key; empty = the listener's default; required for external

label.description: Herdr label of the host inside containers

external.description: the mesh also pushes the host's other loopback Herdr machines (ports 22000-22999, ed25519 key in your known_hosts), mirroring enabled/disabled

agents.description: the host's agent accounts inside containers (docs/config.md); host profile only

host_profiles.description: dck up mounts the host's ak profiles of the CLIs the repository installs (claude codex pi cline grok opencode), the host's ~/.codex when codex is installed, and an allow-listed env file read-only

host_env_keys.description: variable names (or NAME_* prefixes) copied from the host's ak env file into the container's env file, besides CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN and CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN_*
